en-US.whatsNew:
Reminders you can rely on: the day before an Uposatha and an hour before it, and for meal time (kāla and vikāla) — scheduled on your phone, they arrive even when the app is closed.

Every time follows your phone's clock and time zone: dawn, noon, the next reminder.

Widgets and the Control Center control show the moon's real phase, also on a locked phone.

Also: pull to refresh, a smoother theme switch, and many smaller fixes.
